Hi Phillip,

Good news, that address is already on your order and at our warehouse, so nothing is pending on your side.

It now reads: Phillip W., (address hidden). I checked both the order and the warehouse shipment, and they match.

Nothing has shipped yet, so there was no risk of it going to the old address. Your Magic Miner 40T, with the Miner Duster and Power Kit, goes out in one parcel. The units are expected to ship out from the factory on November 12, and your tracking number comes to this email the moment your miner ships to you. You can follow the shipment on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

If anything in that address needs correcting, just reply here and I'll change it.

Best, Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
